column1: # HAND-MEASURED TRUTH for each row of `walls.tsv`. TAB-separated: id, verdict, how.
# This file is the DENOMINATOR wallcheck.py's error rate is computed against, and it is
# produced BY HAND -- one file read, one run, per row -- not by the instrument. If the
# instrument's verdict disagrees with a row here, wallcheck.py prints the disagreement and
# that row counts as an error. A rule and its own error rate from one script is a comment
# that adds up.
# The verdict vocabulary is the INSTRUMENT'S, not a nicer one, because a truth file that
# renames the answers cannot disagree with the instrument -- it would only ever compare two
# dialects. So:
#   LANDED  a MISSING wall's capability now exists. Retire it: the capability ARRIVED.
#   GONE    a DEFECT/PROSE wall's defect no longer exists. Retire it: the defect is FIXED.
#   STANDS  the wall's prerequisite or defect is still there. The wall is load-bearing.
#   SPLIT   the two trees disagree, so the answer is WAIT. Only a rewrite in flight says this.
#   NRUN    the prerequisite is a re-run, not a symbol. A grep cannot grade this row and the
#           run says so rather than guessing a pattern for it.
#           NRUN       the prerequisite is a re-run, not a symbol. Excluded from the error
#                     rate's denominator and reported, so the exclusion is visible.
# ONE LABELLER. Every row below was measured by the same agent that wrote the anchors, so
# the error rate is a SELF-CONSISTENCY rate, not a cross-labelled one. It cannot detect an
# anchor and its truth that are wrong in the SAME way -- which is exactly the failure mode
# this project documents nine times a day. Stated rather than hidden.
# AND IT WAS WORTH THE COLUMN IMMEDIATELY: wallcheck.py's first run put its error rate at
# 3/14 and on all three rows THE INSTRUMENT WAS RIGHT AND THE LABEL ABOVE WAS WRONG --
# W4, W8 (I had labelled the state of the tree from the working copy alone, while the
# capability lives at HEAD), U7 (I called a def RETIRED because the working copy had lost
# it, while HEAD still carries it), and U2 (my anchor matched only a comment, which the
# filter then dropped and read as a gone defect -- a bug the instrument now refuses). Four
# of eighteen rows were wrong in the hand-measured truth on its first pass.
